seeds.title: janitor sweeps a verify-shaped branch whose id embeds the format prefix
seeds.detail: Under feature/sdlc/{name}, the branch feature/sdlc/feature/sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0 parses with id feature/sdlc/S-001, which the ledger does not hold, so the janitor deletes it as unknown. Within spec (unknown ids go), but a nested name is deleted without a ledger match.

seeds.title: janitor does not validate the format before the sweep
seeds.detail: It calls branches.split only, not validate_format. A format with a stray brace (a/{x}-{name}) or whitespace gives no note, and branch a/{x}-S-999-v0-http-api-0 is deleted as unknown. A non-string branchFormat (5) falls back to the default silently (load_format design).

seeds.title: janitor stops early on a non-object config.json before scratch reaping
seeds.detail: With config.json holding [1,2], scratch_days calls config.get on a list. main() catches it and prints the note 'the janitor stopped early', but old sdlc- scratch dirs are not reaped. No branch is deleted. This code predates S-024.

seeds.title: unusable format skips git worktree prune
seeds.detail: The prune runs inside sweep_branches, so a stale worktree registration stays when the format cannot be read. No branch is deleted, so no harm to the slice.

seeds.title: ledger of non-objects counts as an empty ledger
seeds.detail: slices.json holding [1,'a',null] is a list, so it yields no ids and every verify branch is swept as unknown. An empty list [] behaves the same.
